notes: Copy to <repo-root>/.openviking/config.json and commit it. Settings here apply to everyone who clones the repository; anything private goes in config.local.json next to it, which stays out of git. Both are overridden by OPENVIKING_* and by this machine's ~/.openviking/workspaces/ entry, and neither may carry a url, an api key or any other connection setting. The peer defaults to the git repository; a directory that is not one gets no peer until you replace "source" here with an explicit "id".
